lines.en: I feel my way forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 我在夜里走得比白天快。
lines.en: I move faster at night than in the day.
I keep to the wall, making no sound.

lines.zh: 我的影子比人形宽一些。
lines.en: My shadow is a little wider than a person's.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都蔫了。
lines.en: The grass wilts where I walk.
I drag my steps, closing in slowly.
I come out from behind the tree.
I follow a scent to find my way.
I've walked through every kind of country.
I stop at each step, as if thinking.
I stand with my head tilted.
My fingers pinch at the air.
I'm waiting for the dark to deepen.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿有一点露出来。
lines.en: A little of my teeth shows.
I'm scenting the wind for blood.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤上有一道旧伤。
lines.en: There's an old scar on my skin.
I smile slowly.
I'm counting how long until dawn.
I stand against the wall.
My eyes are bright in the dark.
Your blood smells sweet.
You aren't a Demon Slayer.
I know that uniform.
You've no one with you.
I've been hungry a long while.
You draw that blade slowly.

lines.zh: 天亮之前我有的是时间。
lines.en: I have all the time before dawn.
Do you want to hear me out?
Running won't help.
I step back and cover the wound.
This will heal quickly.
My skin has been cut open.
I grit my teeth; I can't smile.
That one went somewhat deep.
I'm breathing hard.
I get up slowly.
Blood runs down my arm.
I'm staring at you.
I can't die yet.
Take it away; I don't eat cooked food.
I prefer you yourself.
This smells too faint.
What are you holding that up for?
I don't need these things.
Put it down, then walk away.
Keep it to patch yourself up.
I can smell that little bit of blood.
You hit me, and I feel cold.
I slip aside a step.
We're far too close.
I push you half a step back.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划到你的袖口。
lines.en: My nails catch your cuff.
You raise a gust as you pull back.
I barely moved from that.
I slowly straighten up.
I smiled once.
I'm not the only demon.
We keep clear of one another.
That one is far stronger than me.
I never go to see them.
There are only rules between us.
The weak one dies first.
I don't dare get near its scent.
At night I hear them.
Perhaps one day I'll be stronger.
Until then, I'm alone.
I pick up a scrap of cloth.
I'll keep this.
I crush it into a ball.
I gripped it too hard.
This carries a smell of blood.
I tuck it into my clothes.
I tossed it away again.
I glanced at it and smiled.
None of this is any use.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候我就动了。
lines.en: I moved the moment you turned.
One leap covers this distance.

lines.zh: 你身上那道血我看见了。
lines.en: I saw that cut on you.
I don't need to shout.
That tree is behind you.
Tonight you're the only one.
I haven't done this in a long while.
Your breathing has gone shallow.
Can you get away?
A few steps left until dawn.
I'm watching you.
Come over here yourself.
I stay at your rear flank.
You can't land a hit on me.
I circle the tree.

lines.zh: 你的刀光在夜里很显眼。
lines.en: Your blade is very visible at night.
I come out of the shadow.
Your footsteps have lost their rhythm.
I'm fast. Much faster.
Your companions haven't come.
You've backed to the fence.
I am not the slightest bit hurried.
It is still deep dark.
I'm still behind you.
I laughed out loud.
All of this is mine.
A few more steps forward.
You have finally stopped.
I don't know what you're waiting for.
How much further can you run?
My nails dig in.
Blood splashes my hands.
You're swept back.
That one was shallow.
I laughed and came again.
You blocked my claws.
I'm circling your flank.

lines.zh: 我的动作比你想的更快。
lines.en: My moves are quicker than you think.
Your blade grazes my shoulder.
I don't dare let that blade touch me.

lines.zh: 这一下带走了你的力气。
lines.en: That took some of your strength.
You dropped to a knee and rose again.
I drew back half a step.
I'll leave this patch to you.
I'll come back.
Next time will be the next time.
I raise my hand slowly.
The number of cuts on you is growing.
I step out from under the eaves.
The night is just dark enough.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的是月亮。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was the moon.
The smell of blood here is fresh.
I flexed my fingers.
I straightened up slowly.
I am not hungry just yet.
I hear people talking far off.
I walk toward the village gate.
I've smelled this wind before.
I start counting tonight's quarry.
I need to find someone living.
Tonight is very quiet.

lines.zh: 火烧到皮肤，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my skin; I swat at it.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，骨头响了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my bones knock.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我挣得很难看。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I thrash.
Light burns me and I back two steps.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我的动作开始慢。
lines.en: Too long hungry, and my moves slow down.

lines.zh: 雷光照过来，我几乎站不住。
lines.en: The flash leaves me barely standing.

lines.zh: 这里没有夜，也没有影子。
lines.en: There's no night here, and no shadow.
